title: Building request
lead: A manager will call to discuss the plot and the schedule. The configuration and the commercial proposal will arrive by email.

fields.name: Name
fields.commentHint: Where the plot is, when to call — optional
fields.consent: I agree to the processing of my personal data to answer this request, under the <policy>personal data policy</policy>

phone.required: We need a phone number to call you

email.required: We need an email for the proposal

consent.required: We cannot answer the request without your consent

errors.summary: Check the form: {count, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}.

success.title: Request #{reference} received
success.text: An email with the configuration and the proposal is on its way to {email}. A manager will call during working hours.
success.mailbox: In the demo, emails never go to real addresses: a copy of the letter with the configuration and the proposal is in the demo mailbox. A manager will call during working hours.

failure: Could not send the request. Try again — what you typed is kept.
limited: Too many requests in a row. Call us: {phone}.
unknown: Configuration not found. Save it again and retry.
